references.text: The verse describes the conquest of the cities that led to the plundering mentioned in verse 35
The same pattern of taking livestock and spoil from conquered cities is repeated in the battle against Og, king of Bashan
The law of war spoils allowing the Israelites to take livestock and plunder from enemy cities
A similar description of war spoils taken from the Midianites, including livestock and goods
God allows the Israelites to take spoil and livestock from Ai, in contrast to Jericho
The Israelites took livestock and spoil from the northern kings they defeated
